title: UI5 Control
tagline: Run an app inside your UI5 app, Fiori elements page or Work Zone card.
summary: The npm package @abap2ui5/embed-control: the UI5 control z2ui5.embed.Container, which runs an abap2UI5 app - an ABAP class implementing z2ui5_if_app - inside your own UI5 app, next to your own controls, each in its own backend session. The package is the control and nothing else: it loads the abap2UI5 frontend from the installation the app talks to, so it always has that backend's version. The repository carries examples for a freestyle app, Fiori elements apps for OData V4 and V2 and a UI Integration Card, delivered on the branches standard and rap.
features: <z2ui5:Container app="Z2UI5_CL_MY_APP" height="400px"/> in an XML view, or new Container( ) in code
Any number of apps on one page, each in its own backend session
Fiori elements: custom sections and object page extensions that pass the object's keys to the app
A UI Integration Card for SAP Build Work Zone that runs any abap2UI5 app
No copy of the frontend in your app: it comes from the backend through ?z2ui5-bundle
UI5 1.71 or later; works with a strict Content-Security-Policy
requirements: abap2UI5 1.145.0 or later (the first release that serves the frontend through ?z2ui5-bundle); a host that routes by the URL hash, like Fiori elements, needs 1.146.0
A UI5 app built with the UI5 CLI 3 or 4
The app and the abap2UI5 service on one origin, or a proxy that makes them one

notes: In your UI5 app: npm install @abap2ui5/embed-control, list it under includeDependency in ui5.yaml and add the resourceRoot z2ui5.embed: ./thirdparty/z2ui5/embed/ to manifest.json
To try it on a system: pull the branch standard with abapGit - the freestyle example as the BSP Z2UI5_HOST
On a system with RAP: pull the branch rap - the Fiori elements example for OData V2 with its RAP service
